newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi rebounds in morning.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi rebounds in morning.

text.p: Shares in Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd rebounded in Monday morning trade, as investors decided to buy back the shares which had been under heavy selling pressure lately, brokers said.
As of 0036 GMT, the shares were 40 yen higher at 2,080 yen, the second-most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse, with a trade of 2.16 million shares.
"Investors are beginning to buy back some bank shares, but the move is still within technical bounds," a "Big Four" broker said.
